metadata.minute_bucket_boundaries: early: minute < 15, mid: 15 <= minute < 30, late: minute >= 30 (item_ranker.py's _minute_bucket)
metadata.shape_note: global: {item_name: popularity}. hero: {hero_id_str: {item_name: popularity}} (originally keyed by (hero_id:int, item:str) tuple in model.pkl -- re-nested here since JSON object keys must be strings). hero_minute: {hero_id_str: {minute_bucket: {item_name: popularity}}} (originally (hero_id:int, minute_bucket:str, item:str) tuple). All three tables are Bayesian-shrunk toward their parent (hero shrinks toward global, hero_minute shrinks toward hero), per item_ranker.py's compute_item_popularity_tables -- see docs/adr/0020 Decision 5.
